condition: recombinant cargo-free pore-engineered shell expressed in E. coli
notes: Engineered pore point mutant. Intact T=1 shell retained. Fivefold pore diameter ~4.0 Å was calculated from the cryo-EM structure, not directly measured. Shell diameter of 24 nm observed by negative-stain TEM.
shell_sequence_change: Engineered pore-loop variant S1K; H187K relative to the WT reference (curated sequence alignment).
shell_change_alignment_note: Protein alignment of curated design vs WT reference; reference numbering is 1-based. The NLBT-tagged published coding source is not asserted to be identical to the structural construct.
